heroSub: All branches, stock, prescriptions and reports in one place.
title: Sign in
sub: Use your phone number and password
help: Trouble signing in? Contact your owner or branch manager.
wrong: Phone number or password is wrong.

code.title: Enter verification code
code.sub: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.

setup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.sub: Scan with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar.
setup.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app

backup.title: Save your backup codes
backup.sub: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now: print or copy them.
backup.regenerateBody: The old codes stop working. Enter your password to continue.

forced.title: Two-factor is required for your role
forced.body: Owner and Branch manager accounts can approve discounts, see cost and change settings, so they must use 2FA. It takes about 2 minutes.
forced.note: You can't open the app until setup is complete.

locked.title: Account locked
locked.help: Need access sooner? Ask your Owner. The owner has been notified on Telegram.

pin.sub: A 4 to 6 digit PIN for controlled drugs, approvals and witnessing
pin.rule: Don't use repeated (111111) or sequential (123456) digits
pin.mismatch: The two PINs are different. Start again.
pin.passwordToSave: Your password, to save the PIN
